import sys, json, collections
sys.path.insert(0, "/root/unitex-finrep/engine")

c = ODataClient()
rows = []
for i, d in enumerate(c.list("Document_Сделка", order="Number desc", top=40)):

print("ROWS", len(rows), "KEYS", len(rows[0]) if rows else 0)
nonempty = collections.OrderedDict()
for d in rows:
    for k, v in d.items():
        if v not in (None, "", False, 0, "0001-01-01T00:00:00") and str(v) != "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000":
            if k not in nonempty:
                nonempty[k] = str(v)[:40]
print("NONEMPTY", len(nonempty))
for k, v in nonempty.items():
    print("%-42s %s" % (k, v))
print("=== ALL KEYS ===")
